verdict: Combined conversation/control implemented, independently reviewed and tested without the physical robot; undeployed candidate.
user_correction: Natural conversation and movement must remain in the same mode. The previous conversation/movement split is superseded; receipt-only remains optional diagnostics.
scope: No SSH, real robot, motor commands or physical media capture. Two bounded actual-Gemini text sessions used fake ROS. Chrome used synthetic streams, mock Google and localhost fake API. Existing key read privately for those cloud probes; no account or permission changes.

contract.default: All robot tools plus natural conversation in one connection. Missing/new settings select conversation; explicit saved receipt-only preserved; invalid mode selects receipt-only. Local fake app was switched through its UI to combined mode. Pi settings unchanged.
contract.hard_boundary: Model audio/text/speech aliases buffered synchronously before any tool await. Any robot-tool-bearing turn discards model narration. Matched current API replies alone generate fixed receipts; queued requires actual insertion marker. Tools and Stop dispatch immediately, independently of speech.
contract.conversation: Tool-free turns release native audio after turnComplete with nonempty available output transcript; text/aliases use the same screening boundary. English claim heuristics screen exact assembled text. This is not a semantic truth or audio/transcript alignment guarantee.
contract.stale_output: Interruption, Stop, cancellation, disconnect and overflow drop buffered output and retain a dropped-turn marker until boundary, preventing stale tails from playing. A later legitimate conversation can resume without reconnecting.

bounds.cli: 20-second output expiry checked on incoming content, not a receive/network timeout.

contract.speech: Code-owned receipts and known-claim fallback use bounded local WebSpeech; model native voice remains for eligible conversation. Tool execution does not await either speech path.
contract.cli: Combined default; --conversation alias retained; --receipts-only diagnostics suppress model narration. Thought-marked model parts excluded from operator text.

independent_review.verdict: No remaining blocking lifecycle finding within the inspected turn-gate scope. Deterministic receipt provenance is separate from heuristic no-tool screening.

limits: A tool-free paraphrase, another language, implied or cross-turn claim may evade screening. Quotes or explanations may be blocked.
Nonempty output transcript does not prove complete correspondence with native audio. Only available text is screened.
Whole-turn buffering adds conversational playback latency and omits conversational content mixed into a robot-tool turn.
No new terminal completion, physical pose, stopping or user-intent proof. No policy promotion or changed gains/limits.
Real browser microphone/Gemini/speaker integration and physical robot behavior remain untested for this candidate.
